knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: Gamma chain
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Let F be a continuous strictly increasing distribution function and U be Uniform(0, 1). Which variable has distribution function F?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Inverse transform maps a uniform probability through the target quantile function.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Generate U uniformly and set X = F inverse(U).
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Applying the distribution function rather than its inverse.

choices.label: X = 1 minus U for every F.
X = log(U) regardless of the support of F.

knowledge_checks.title: Revision Checkpoint: univariate generation and placement
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. To generate an Exponential distribution with rate lambda from U distributed Uniform(0, 1), which formula is valid?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: The exponential quantile is -log(1-u)/lambda, and 1-U is also uniform.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Use X = -log(1-U)/lambda and verify non-negative support.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Multiplying by the rate instead of dividing by it.
